reviews.review:
Cute, engaging game for single players or with up to 3 friends. The art is creative and unique, and each hamster feels like its own little character with a story. The music is nice and fits the theme, creating a playful, chaotic atmosphere.

The controls are good, though I’m still getting used to them and to the overall chaos of the matches. It’s new for me, but it’s chaos in a fun way!

The game is also child-friendly, even for the youngest players. So parents—grab your little ones, pick a hamster, and jump into the arena! :-)

Considering it comes from a single developer, it’s a very impressive game. It just needs a bit of polishing in some areas and a finalized storyline, but that’s still in active development. It’s clear that a lot of love, dedication, and effort went into this game. Absolutely love it!
